description: This file defines the UsbMidiDeviceAndroid class, which manages USB MIDI device interactions on Android, including connection handling, data transfer, and event posting.

classes.name: UsbMidiDeviceAndroid
classes.description: Manages USB MIDI device communication, including connection setup, data transfer, and event handling.

methods.name: UsbMidiDeviceAndroid
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the USB MIDI device, claims interfaces, and starts listening for input endpoints.

methods.name: startListen
methods.description: Begins listening for input data on USB endpoints, creating a thread to handle incoming data.

methods.name: postOnDataEvent
methods.description: Posts incoming data events to the main thread, invoking native callback.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Checks if the device connection is closed.

methods.name: registerSelf
methods.description: Associates a native pointer with this Java object.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends data to the USB MIDI device via specified endpoint.

methods.name: shouldUseBulkTransfer
methods.description: Determines if bulk transfer should be used for sending data.

methods.name: getDescriptors
methods.description: Retrieves raw descriptors bytes of the device.

methods.name: getStringDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves string descriptor bytes for a given index.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the device connection and releases resources.

methods.name: getInputDataLength
methods.description: Calculates the length of input data in a ByteBuffer.
